modules.core.name: Global Configuration
modules.core.description: The core module of the application, managing core commands and events. It is always loaded.
modules.thread-creator.name: Thread Creator
modules.thread-creator.description: Automatically creates discussion threads under each new message in configured channels.
modules.autoreact.name: Auto React
modules.autoreact.description: Automatically adds a reaction to every new message in the channels set with /autoreact.
modules.four-hour-game.name: 4h Game
modules.four-hour-game.description: Score a point when your message stays the last one in the game channel for the configured delay, and a daily point for the longest hold of the day.
modules.rngdle.name: RNGdle
modules.rngdle.description: Tracks the members' rngdle.com rolls: leaderboards, profiles, server statistics and a daily leaderboard.
modules.reports.name: Reports
modules.reports.description: Lets members report a message with a reaction or the context menu; moderators get an alert with actions.
modules.message-log.name: Message Log
modules.message-log.description: Logs deleted and edited messages in a staff channel.
modules.message-quote.name: Message Quote
modules.message-quote.description: Quotes the Discord messages whose link is posted, for members allowed to read them.
modules.latex.name: LaTeX
modules.latex.description: Renders LaTeX formulas as images with the /latex command, and the messages containing LaTeX.
modules.server-stats.name: Server Stats
modules.server-stats.description: Counts the server's daily activity and posts a report every night.
modules.test-config.name: Test Config
modules.test-config.description: Development module declaring all configuration types, used to test the configuration UI.
config.locale.name: Language
pings.enabled: The bot will ping you again in its announcements on this server.
pings.disabled: The bot will no longer ping you in its announcements on this server. Your name still appears in them.
guild.welcome.title: # Thanks for inviting me!
guild.welcome.body: Admins, start with `/modules` to enable modules and `/config` to configure them.
guild.welcome.hint: Your previous configuration will be restored automatically if I have been here before.
